tag.name: GA4 - page_meta
tag.notes: Sends page_meta to GA4 G-3F4CN946HC. Source: tracking.js, once per page view; pushes page_type and page_name.

tag.name: GA4 - internal_link_click
tag.notes: Sends internal_link_click to GA4 G-3F4CN946HC. Source: tracking.js, delegated click on Next cards, Next essay links, editorial cards, essay nav.

tag.name: GA4 - essay_progress
tag.notes: Sends essay_progress to GA4 G-3F4CN946HC. Source: tracking.js, essays only, 25/50/75/100 once each per page view; pushes page_type 'essay'.

tag.name: GA4 - essay_complete
tag.notes: Sends essay_complete to GA4 G-3F4CN946HC. Source: tracking.js, essays only, at most once per page view; pushes page_type 'essay'.

tag.name: GA4 - page_not_found
tag.notes: Sends page_not_found to GA4 G-3F4CN946HC. Source: inline script in 404.html; pushed before page_meta, so page_type is not yet in the data model for this event and GA4 receives none.

tag.name: GA4 - outbound_link_click
tag.notes: Sends outbound_link_click to GA4 G-3F4CN946HC. Source: tracking.js, click on any http(s) link to another host.

tag.name: GA4 - in_page_nav
tag.notes: Sends in_page_nav to GA4 G-3F4CN946HC. Source: script.js trackEvent, click on an in-page anchor; does not push page_type itself, the tag reads the value page_meta left in the data model.

tag.name: GA4 - copy_to_clipboard
tag.notes: Sends copy_to_clipboard to GA4 G-3F4CN946HC. Source: script.js trackEvent in copyText(); value is the copied text. copyText() has no caller on main 14b7ccb, so this event does not fire today; check value carries no personal data before wiring it to a copy button.

variable.name: DLV - page_type
variable.notes: Data Layer Variable for page_type (home, section, hub, essay, error, unknown). tracking.js pushes it with page_meta first thing on every page, and GTM keeps it in the data model, so this variable has a value on every later event of the page view. Existing GA4 event tags (container v7) that should gain an event parameter page_type = {{DLV - page_type}}: the tags for nav_click, project_card_click, feature_toggle, section_view, recommendation_modal_open, language_change, source_link_click, theme_change, experience_toggle, project_toggle, projects_filter_update, projects_view_change, cta_click, mobile_nav_toggle, accordion_section_expanded, ai_widget_toggle, ai_chat_interaction, dashboard_teaser_tab_click, dashboard_fullscreen_toggled, dashboard_refresh_clicked, dashboard_outbound_clicked, collaboration_view_change, collaboration_preset_preview. Add it by hand after the import; the import file does not touch existing tags. See .agents/gtm/README.md.
